title: Saturday 4 April 2026
headline: Key Developments in Financial Auditing and Disclosure Practices
intro: On 4 April 2026, significant updates emerged in the realms of financial auditing and market disclosures. The European Supervisory Authorities (ESAs) have reported enhanced efforts by financial market participants in disclosing principal adverse impacts, while the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) continues to refine its guidelines and technic…
summary: The statutory audit remains a cornerstone of corporate governance, ensuring that financial statements are certified for accuracy and reliability. This process is crucial for stakeholders, including investors and shareholders, who rely on audited financial records to make informed decisions. The recent report by ESMA highlights the importance of these audits in maintaining market integrity and trust. In addition, the ESAs have observed a notable increase in the voluntary disclosure of principal adverse impacts by financial market participants. This trend reflects a growing commitment to transparency and responsible business practices, aligning with broader sustainability goals. The fourth annual report on these disclosures indicates a positive shift towards greater accountability in the financial sector, reinforcing the need for ongoing vigilance and regulatory support.
key_points: The ESAs note greater effort from financial market participants in their disclosure of principal adverse impacts
